arabic text: Lahu lahu hai musalla, Lahu lahu hai jabee(n)\nAy zulmm dekkh zara, kahin ali to nahi
english translation text: The prayer mat is drenched in blood, and so is the forehead.\nO oppression, look carefully—could this be Ali?

arabic text: Yeh waar kispe huwa hai,laraz gaya Kaaba\nLabe hayaat pe thehri huwi hai kun ki sada\nFalak Hy Noha Kuna, To matami hai zameen
english translation text: Upon whom has this blow fallen, making the Kaaba tremble?\nThe command 'Be' stands frozen upon the lips of life.\nThe heavens recite lament, and the earth performs matam.

arabic text: Laraz rahi hai namazein tarap rahi hai azaan\nKhuda ke khoon se tar hogaya khuda ka makaan\nHai sogwaare ali, tamam e arsh e makeen
english translation text: Prayers tremble and the adhan writhes;\nthe house of God is soaked in the blood of God's wali.\nAll those upon the Throne and earth mourn Ali.

arabic text: Padar jahaan se hasnain ka guzar ta hai\nTamam kufa hi lekin yateem lagta hai\nYateem aaj huwa Khuda rasool ka deen
english translation text: Wherever Hasanayn's father once passed,\nall of Kufa now appears orphaned.\nToday the religion of God and the Messenger has become orphaned.

arabic text: Yeh bayn karti hai Zainab, na jaiye baba\nLipat ke ghazi se kulsoom ne kiya girya\nTarap rahe hai hasan, Kahin Hussain kahin
english translation text: Zainab laments: do not go, Baba.\nKulsum clings to Ghazi and weeps.\nHasan writhes here, and Hussain there.

arabic text: Kiya hai zulm ye kaisa, dile payambar per\nHuwa hai haalat e roza me waar haider per\nBaqi se kufe chalee, Hai fatema bhi hazeen
english translation text: What oppression has been committed against the Prophet's heart?\nHaider was struck while fasting.\nFrom Baqi, grieving Fatima journeys towards Kufa.

arabic text: Ghulame hur kahin salman ho ata rutba\nYehi musala e matam me kar rha ho dua\nKafan ho farsh e aza, Lahad najaf ki zameen
english translation text: May the servant of Hurr receive Salman's rank.\nUpon the mourning mat he prays:\nmay the mourning floor be my shroud, and Najaf's earth my grave.
